The current K-12 education systems and many robotics institutes emphasize creativity and cognitive skills through short-term STEM programs but fall short in providing students with the advanced technical skills required for Industry 5.0. This leads to a gap between theoretical knowledge and practical application, leaving students unprepared for careers in robotics, AI, smart cities, and IoT. Additionally, many institutions rely on imported robotics equipment, which often lacks local technical support, after-sales services, and reliable customer assistance. This dependency restricts access to quality learning platforms and creates unequal opportunities for students to engage with cutting-edge technologies, limiting their ability to participate in the future industrial revolution.

To address these challenges, we are developing indigenously built robots that equip students with Industry 5.0 skills, such as Robot Operating System (ROS), Wi-Fi, and ESP-32, creating a unified platform for K-12 to higher education. We have a vision to build a global robotic ecosystem through our **Internet-of-Robots** for education, scaling learning across boundaries with remotely accessible, programmable platforms. Additionally, our **Smart Downtown**, a scaled-down miniature city, replicates real-world problems to be solved using our indigenous technology, providing practical, hands-on learning experiences.

🔴 THE PROBLEM:

• Companies spend an average of $3,864 per hire (Johnson Service Group, 2019).
• 75% of hiring professionals lose top talent due to lengthy hiring processes (ManpowerGroup, 2024).

ATS tools are widely used to speed up hiring processes. BUT:

• 88% of employers find that ATS often miss top talent (Harvard Business Review, 2021).
• 37% of employers are dissatisfied with the effectiveness of ATS (TrustRadius, 2021).

MOREOVER:

• 57% of hiring managers take less than 3 minutes to review a résumé (Resume Genius, 2024).

With hiring timelines averaging 42 days (ManpowerGroup, 2024), many skilled candidates miss opportunities because recruiters can't review thousands of applications in detail.

ADDITIONALLY:

• 68% of Gen Z workers report getting jobs through personal connections (FORTUNE, 2023).

This highlights a critical market gap for a robust and efficient shortlisting tool that helps employers quickly identify top candidates from thousands of applications and ensures 100% transparency for job seekers, focusing on skill-first hiring.

🟢 THE SOLUTION:

Fastrack is Pakistan's first AI-powered talent search engine, helping you find, engage, and schedule candidates for specific roles with 100% transparency, all in minutes, using natural language queries. It's like ChatGPT, but for hiring!

Fastrack uses self-reflecting AI agents to simulate a recruiter, rapidly searching and ranking candidates from extensive databases as a human would. It automates the process up to the first interview, cutting manual screening costs by >90% and reducing recruitment time to a few days. Fastrack also automates pre-screening calls with human-like AI voice agents.

We're empowering recruiters by automating their candidate outreach, helping them reach quality candidates faster so that the final interview is the only thing they need to focus on.

Problem Statement for Trumpple:
Small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs) often struggle to manage their finances and operations efficiently. They are forced to use multiple software solutions for accounting, customer relationship management (CRM), invoicing, and project management, leading to a fragmented workflow. This fragmentation not only increases costs and complexity but also makes it harder for business owners to have real-time visibility into their financial performance. Furthermore, SMBs often lack the resources to invest in high-end enterprise solutions, leaving them dependent on inadequate, outdated, or overly complex tools that don’t cater to their specific needs.

What Trumpple is Doing:
Trumpple is addressing this problem by providing an all-in-one SaaS platform designed specifically for SMBs. It offers a comprehensive suite of financial management tools, simplifying operations and providing real-time insights. Here’s what Trumpple does in detail:

Streamlined Invoicing and Estimates: Trumpple allows businesses to create and send professional invoices and estimates quickly. The platform supports multiple currencies, making it ideal for global businesses. With automatic reminders for overdue payments, Trumpple helps improve cash flow by ensuring timely payments.

Customer Relationship Management (CRM): Trumpple integrates CRM functionalities, enabling businesses to track customer interactions, manage leads, and build stronger relationships. This feature helps users manage and nurture leads effectively, turning prospects into loyal clients.

Multi-Role with Permissions: The platform provides advanced user management, allowing businesses to assign different roles to team members and set permissions based on their roles, ensuring data security and efficient workflow.

Multi-Business Management: Trumpple supports the management of multiple businesses under a single account. This feature is especially beneficial for entrepreneurs or business owners who run multiple enterprises, giving them centralized control over all operations.

Seamless Tax and Expense Management: Trumpple simplifies tax calculations and expense tracking, ensuring compliance and reducing errors. It offers seamless integration with tax regulations, making financial reporting easier.

Multilingual and RTL Support: To cater to a global audience, Trumpple is multilingual, offering both Left-to-Right (LTR) and Right-to-Left (RTL) language support, making it accessible to businesses across different regions.

Offline Payment Methods: Trumpple allows users to handle offline payments, ensuring that businesses can manage all payment types, including cash, checks, or bank transfers.

Advanced Reporting and Analytics: The platform provides detailed, AI-powered insights into financial data. With customizable reports, SMBs can easily track performance, make data-driven decisions, and forecast future trends.

Budgeting and Forecasting: Trumpple’s financial planning tools help businesses set budgets, forecast revenue, and keep track of their financial health, improving long-term planning.

Third-Party Integrations: Trumpple integrates seamlessly with other popular business tools like payment gateways, CRM systems, and project management platforms, creating a unified business ecosystem.

Project Management and Time Tracking: The platform offers project management and time tracking features, enabling businesses to manage tasks and projects effectively while tracking billable hours for clients.

AI-Powered Insights: Trumpple uses artificial intelligence to analyze financial data and provide actionable insights. This helps SMBs identify opportunities for cost-saving, revenue growth, and optimization.

My Team Feature: With this feature, businesses can manage their teams more efficiently by assigning tasks, tracking performance, and monitoring employee productivity all within the platform.
